current_architecture.data_flow: The current website injects data via <script src="./public/data/packages.js"></script> into window.SMEAR_PACKAGES, window.SMEAR_CATEGORIES, and window.SMEAR_TESTS, with fallback to fetch().
current_architecture.package_schema: Legacy BookMyTest schema relying heavily on 'sourceData' (e.g. preview_content, detailed_content). JavaScript dynamically parses raw text strings to extract prices, discounts, faqs, and profiles.
current_architecture.test_schema: Legacy BookMyTest schema with 'test_name', 'lab', and 'price' as a string (e.g. '₹ 1500'). Javascript uses regex to extract the numeric price.
current_architecture.cart_schema: Stored in localStorage ('smear_cart_v1') as an array of {id, type, name, price, qty}. Prices coerce falsey values to 0.
current_architecture.category_architecture: Categories are defined in package-categories.json with a hardcoded list of {id, name, packageCount} and are mapped in packages.js to local hardcoded icons and colors.

target_architecture.data_flow: The website should directly fetch() 'smear-packages.json', 'smear-tests.json', and 'smear-categories.json' from 'public/data/'. Window object injection will be deprecated.

integration_plan.packages: Update src/packages.js to fetch smear-packages.json. Remove extractPrice() and extractDiscount(). Use the native JSON fields.
integration_plan.tests: Update src/blood-tests.js to fetch smear-tests.json. Replace regex price extraction with direct property access. Switch test_name to name.
integration_plan.categories: Update src/packages.js and src/global-search.js to fetch smear-categories.json. Map the new standardized category IDs to the existing UI icons.
integration_plan.search_filter: Update src/global-search.js to search against the normalized JSON dataset (name, category_id, profiles array).
integration_plan.pagination: Preserve existing client-side pagination in blood-tests.js. It efficiently slices the dataset into 48-item chunks.
integration_plan.detail_page: Update src/package-detail.js. Completely remove parseDetailedContent() regex parser. Directly iterate over pkg.profiles and pkg.faqs arrays.
integration_plan.cart_handling: Update src/cart.js to accept price === null. Do not coerce null to 0. In UI, display 'Price available at lab'. In WhatsApp, output 'To be confirmed' instead of '₹0'. Total calculation should only sum valid numeric prices and append a note about unpriced items.
integration_plan.image_strategy: Use the existing neutral SVG placeholders defined in packages.js and blood-tests.js since image_url is null and we must not download external images.

migration_sequence: 1. Update src/cart.js to handle null prices safely without coercing to 0.
2. Copy smear-packages.json, smear-tests.json, and smear-categories.json to public/data/.
3. Update src/blood-tests.js to fetch and render from smear-tests.json.
4. Update src/packages.js and src/global-search.js to fetch and render from new JSON files. Remove all string/regex parsing logic.
5. Update src/package-detail.js to render cleanly from the structured JSON schema (profiles/faqs) and remove parseDetailedContent().
6. Deprecate and remove legacy BookMyTest data files.
rollback_strategy: All changes are confined to frontend JavaScript and data files. A rollback requires reverting the /src directory and restoring the legacy /public/data files from source control.
risks: Cart state corruption: Existing users may have old legacy package IDs in their localStorage cart. If cart.js fails to find a matching ID during render, it may throw errors.
Missing hardcoded icons: New standardized category IDs might not perfectly map to the hardcoded CAT_ICONS dictionary in packages.js, leading to fallback icons.
